correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, nodes umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068

low_level: Registers 23 to 225 over the 226 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (2 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 48 to 33024 bytes, harness 0.10 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 4 to 4 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, no cell unsupported, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 9 of 18 cells (7 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T16, 2 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, runner-up in 2), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 7 of 12 cells (runner-up in 1), throughput not_guaranteed wins 12 of 18 cells (8 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, 3 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T8, 1 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T16, runner-up in 2), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 6 of 12 cells (3 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T8, 2 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, 1 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T16, runner-up in 3).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 32, bf16 N 128, fp32 N 8, fp32 N 16, fp32 N 32, fp32 N 64, fp32 N 128), the median margin over the runner-up is +54 percent and over the scope's reference control +276 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): fp32 N 8 k 4 +219 percent behind W1_eager_same_sub@T4 in latency not_guaranteed, bf16 N 128 k 64 +215 percent behind N5_rows_fs_sub@T16 in throughput not_guaranteed, fp32 N 128 k 64 +157 percent behind N10_auto_sub@T16 in latency not_guaranteed, fp32 N 8 k 2 +83 percent behind W1_eager_same_sub@T4 in latency not_guaranteed.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 4 of 11 cells (3 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T8, 1 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, runner-up in 5), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 5 of 10 cells (3 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T8, 1 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, 1 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T16, runner-up in 4), throughput not_guaranteed wins 7 of 11 cells (4 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, 3 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T8, runner-up in 0), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 5 of 10 cells (3 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T8, 2 as W2_packed_sw_v2@T4, runner-up in 0).
Named workloads won on random input: deepseek_v3_group_select, deepseek_v3_group_top2, moba_32k_b512_top3, moe_dbrx, moe_gpt_oss_20b, moe_mixtral_8x7b.
negative: No cell where this adapter was the winner changed hands against the control in the same lock section. Deficits above are against other adapters of the same scope.
surprises: The named sub-warp workloads pick the 16-lane form on 4 of 6 cells once every lane count is measured (the first pass ran them at 4 lanes only).

On B200 the named-workload rows at 8 and 16 lanes come from the umbriel-b200-068 addendum (the 047 pass ran the named sub-warp cells at 4 lanes only), so the lane-count choice there is a cross-node comparison, and the single-host evidence is the GB200 pass on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99.
open_questions: GB200 pass on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99 (WINNERS_gb200.md): the warp and sub-warp winners agree on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. The GB200 k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property).
